purpose: Machine-readable evidence map for the Stage 7 assurance controls. CI run identifiers and final counts are recorded separately in the closing report because they are run-specific.

evidenceKinds.static: Executed by npm run audit:stage7 or an equivalent deterministic repository/schema check.
evidenceKinds.production-runtime: Executed by playwright.production.config.ts against next start.
evidenceKinds.development-runtime: Executed by the normal Playwright E2E suite against the development server.
evidenceKinds.documented-boundary: Intentionally deferred behavior that must remain explicitly unclaimed rather than being treated as implemented.
